summary: Compute whole groups and a remainder together.
documentation: divmod returns quotient and remainder together. For integers the pair corresponds to a // b and a % b. Division by zero raises ZeroDivisionError; floor division affects the sign behavior of negative inputs.
inputs: Two numbers, with a nonzero divisor.
returns: A two-item tuple: quotient and remainder.
caution: The quotient uses floor division, not truncation toward zero. Restrict inputs or define negative-value behavior deliberately.
scenarios: Calculate full cartons and leftover units.
Convert a duration into whole hours plus remaining minutes.
Split a budget into equal integer allocations and a remainder.
title: Pack whole cartons
problem: Input has integer fields units >= 0 and capacity > 0. Return a JSON-compatible list [fullCartons, leftoverUnits]. Do not round up partial cartons.
goal: Use divmod() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use divmod(units, capacity), then convert its tuple to a list.
